card.name: Should after stopping a drug
card.fires_on: The word "should" right after "drug discontinuation" in tardive dyskinesia warnings. Also a comma after "medication should be tapered" in discontinuation advice.

modes.label: Should after discontinuation
modes.description: The word "should" following "drug discontinuation" in a tardive dyskinesia warning.
modes.example: If signs and symptoms of tardive dyskinesia appear in a patient on antipsychotics, drug discontinuation<< should>> be considered.

modes.label: Comma after tapered
modes.description: A comma after "medication should be tapered" in advice about stopping treatment.
modes.example: If the decision has been made to discontinue treatment, medication should be tapered<<,>> as rapidly as is feasible, but with

card.writes: It promotes hedging words like "generally" and "usually", which suggests the next words soften a general statement.
card.plain: It marks the spot in stop-the-drug advice where a qualifying word such as "generally" might come next.
